name: devideo
description: Desktop app to auto-generate video commercials using Google Flow and AI

scripts.engine:build: cd engine && bun build src/server-entry.ts --compile --external chromium-bidi --outfile ../src-tauri/binaries/engine && cp ../src-tauri/binaries/engine ../src-tauri/binaries/engine-aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.engine:build:win: cd engine && bun build src/server-entry.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64-baseline --external chromium-bidi --outfile ../src-tauri/binaries/engine.exe
